description: Video to a good-looking GIF or animated WebP: a palette built from the clip itself, your choice of part, frame rate and width, and an optional size cap the tool hits by itself (for Discord, GitHub READMEs, Slack). Price: $0.03 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of Media tools: Video and audio chores for sites, apps and docs: turn a clip into a small GIF or animated WebP, compress video to web-ready MP4/WebM with a poster, pull thumbnails and a contact sheet, extract or convert audio with loudness normalization, draw waveforms, and probe a file for what will not play in browsers..

colors.description: GIF palette size. Fewer colours, smaller file.

duration.description: How many seconds to keep. To the end when omitted.

format.description: gif plays everywhere; animated webp is about half the size with full colour.

maxBytes.description: Keep the file under this size: the tool lowers frame rate and width until it fits (Discord wants 10 MB, GitHub 10 MB, Slack 2 MB for inline play).

video.description: Video file as base64 (MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV, AVI or GIF).

width.description: Output width; height follows the aspect ratio. Never upscales.

name: media_tools_video_to_gif
